author: Lindsey Watson
title: Brightside Project filling gap during SNAP pause - NewsBreak
text:
By Lindsey Watson ,
1 hours ago
SALEM, Ohio (WKBN) – As the government shutdown drags on, more local families are feeling the strain. The Brightside Project is stepping up , offering food and hot meals to children and families who might otherwise go without.
Inside The Brightside Project Wednesday, volunteers filled around 400 bags of food — easy meals and snacks for kids whose families are struggling through the government shutdown. Each one represents one less child that will go hungry in our community. Two hundred were gone within the first hour.
Related stories:
“Our goal is to just be the light during these dark times,” said Lisa Vittorio, with the Brightside Project. “It speaks to where our families are, the struggle they’re having to go through.”
A painful sign of just how deep the need runs and how often they’ve had to do this.
“It’s really unfortunate that this is the third time in five years we’ve had to mobilize our crisis relief team,” Vittorio said.
This effort is part of Brightside’s Crisis Relief for Kids initiative, a simple idea that’s bringing comfort and stability when things feel uncertain.
“Every glimmer of hope we can give these kids — it’s a tool to help them build resilience and overcome adversity they experience in life,” Vittorio said.
For families like Aubrie Howard’s, this means more than a meal; it’s hope after having just moved to the area.
“We are so thankful we had this opportunity come about with everything that is going on,” Howard said. “I’m just so grateful that we have something like this to turn to in times like these. It is really nice to be able to look to our community to come together.”
The Brightside Project says any family affected by the shutdown, federal workers or SNAP recipients, can reach out through Facebook, phone, or email for help.
The nonprofit will be having another food giveaway next Tuesday, Nov. 11, from 4-6 p.m. at its building on North Ellsworth Avenue in Salem.
